hero.lead: From the field to the world, one complete chain. Grupo Saturno integrates livestock production, an export meat industry, and supply across all of Uruguay — together with our Saturno Premium cuts, specialty stores, countryside restaurant, and Barbaco, our daily delivery service.

about.label: The Group
about.body: Grupo Saturno is a 100% Uruguayan company with over 36 years in the meat industry. We operate two own plants — Frigorífico Saturno and Establecimiento Florida 365 — with active approvals to export to China (GACC), the United States (USDA), the European Union, and third countries. Every animal is individually identified from birth, under the world's most rigorous traceability system. From slaughter to shipment, without intermediaries.
about.stat3Phrase: A whole world as our destination

mvv.label: Purpose
mvv.mision: To reach the table of every corner of the World, bringing food that fosters nutrition, health, moments of togetherness, happiness and peace.
mvv.vision:
To be a company that constantly learns and evolves, optimising resources and nurturing a skilled and committed team, with appropriate infrastructure, equipment and a positive working environment, in order to offer comprehensive solutions and adapt them to our clients' needs.

We are committed to sustainable growth and continuous improvement, seeking to generate a positive impact on our team, clients, partners and the community.

We aspire to remain recognised for our empathy, integrity and reliability — fundamental and non-negotiable values — strengthening strategic and lasting relationships with all stakeholders, while maintaining a competitive spirit.

valores.desc: Every production cycle as an opportunity to improve.
Sustained effort as the only true guarantee.
36 years demand knowing when to change course.
To the product, the team, and the client.
Understanding others is integral to doing business.

chain.label: How we work
chain.body1: We are a serious company that respects every process of animal welfare, food safety, food security, quality, sustainability and traceability.
chain.body2: We are defined by our ability to adapt to the needs of each market and, above all, of each client.

items.title: From slaughter to shipment — inside the group
items.text: Establecimiento Florida 365 is our own slaughter plant. We produce, process, and export without handing control to third parties. One point of contact, real traceability at every stage.

items.title: The whole world. One supplier.
items.text: We are approved for the most demanding destinations. A whole world as our destination.

items.title: The most rigorous traceability system on the planet
items.text: Uruguay is the only country in the world where 100% of the bovine herd is individually identified electronically from birth, by law. Every animal we process has a complete, verifiable history.

items.title: Grass-fed Uruguayan beef: the world's best, with scientific backing
items.text: A study published in Meat Sciences (Netherlands) concludes that Uruguay scientifically produces the best beef in the world. No growth hormones, on natural pastures year-round.

florida.presentationBody: Establecimiento Florida 365 is our export meat plant: slaughter, deboning and storage. Approved for the most demanding markets — China (GACC), the United States (USDA) and the European Union — it is the group's window to the world: from the field to every destination, without intermediaries.

saturno.presentationH2: Cycle 2, dedicated to the Uruguayan domestic market
saturno.presentationBody1: Founded in 1990, Frigorífico Saturno is the group's cycle 2: a national logistics and distribution centre with its plant at Route 8 Km 38, Empalme Olmos, Canelones. We supply the whole country with a fleet of more than 40 vehicles and a volume exceeding 1,000 tonnes per month.
saturno.presentationBody2: "From the outset, the reason for being of Frigorífico Saturno: Uruguayan DNA."
saturno.distBody: A fleet of more than 40 vehicles with state-of-the-art refrigeration equipment that guarantees the cold chain from the plant to the delivery point.
capacity: Processing of more than 12,000 tonnes per year
saturno.premiumBody: The beef Uruguay exports to the world's most demanding markets, now available to the Uruguayan consumer. Angus and Hereford steers and heifers, natural pasture grazing, balanced supplementation without growth hormones.

saturno.identityBody1: A company is truly national not only because of the composition of its capital, the jobs it generates, or the market it serves, but, fundamentally, because it was born in this country and is deeply rooted in its culture, its values, and its traditions.
saturno.identityBody2: Educated in classrooms, forged through the bonds that grow in neighbourhoods, and raised under the dreams that define Uruguayan identity —the stadium, the tablados, the unmistakable voice of el Mago—, we find in that authentic and collective Uruguay the strength that drives and sustains us. It is the shared dream of every Uruguayan, and of all of us together, the engine that makes our company what it is today.
